summary: Woman hiker broke her foot several hundred yards up the trail at the Sutton Mine trailhead. Another hiker helped her most of the way down; OMRT ran a half-hour wheeled-litter operation for the final stretch to the ambulance.
notes: Bystander assisted most of the carry.
